gen-dafont-redux-gf-montserrat-alternate: Contemporary and geometric, Redux stretches its wide-spaced letters across the line. Redux is best at big curved entrances; Montserrat Alternates is best at a spaghetti-thin line of chalky lowercase.
gen-dafont-sophia-fs-supreme: Supreme, a plain sans with a heavy-looking band of text, sits under Sophia and its flowing pen-written letters. Reading it feels dense, with letters held open instead of curled shut.
gen-dafont-sophia-manrope: Loose pen script from Sophia up top, then Manrope below with bright open gaps at every curve. Reading along feels light and unfussy, each stroke holding its width steadily.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-cascadia-code: Dreamy, drifting Starborn leaves wide gaps between letters and lays a dark stripe of lowercase through each line. Cascadia Code runs a wire-like sans-serif line, every bend smooth and unobstructed.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-lexend-giga: Lexend Giga is a plain sans with generous tracking, opening each word. Beside it, Stencilia feels structural and striking, its spacious curve gaps against the flat, single-weight linework underneath.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-julius-sans-one: Spread out and refined, Stentiga lets its tracking breathe, with crossbars matching the stems. Julius Sans One, a plain sans, keeps capitals and lowercase close in height with open-ended curves, so text moves loosely.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-lexend-zetta: Lexend Zetta, a plain sans of cut-ribbon strokes and tall small letters, sits widely tracked right beneath Stentiga. Both are widely spaced, so the page feels refined and unhurried.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-cascadia-mono: Nostalgic and digital, Visitor pulls gaping-mouthed letters like solder, while Cascadia Mono stands in rows like pins. The standout is sturdy, compact lettering, with curves matching the straight stems.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-lexend-mega: Gaping mouths and short ascenders in Visitor, one-nib lines in Lexend Mega. Visitor is best at nostalgic, digital attitude; Lexend Mega, a plain sans, is best at lowercase nearly matching the capitals.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-lexend-zetta: Visitor brings nostalgic, digital letters with gaping mouths and short ascenders over big bowls. Lexend Zetta adds ribbon-like strokes of constant width, and that tall, widely tracked body is the standout.
